references.text: Psalm 127:3-5 speaks of children as a heritage from the Lord, emphasizing their importance in God's eyes, similar to how Jesus wanted to bless the children in Matthew 19:13.
In Matthew 18:2-6, Jesus uses a child as an example of those who are greatest in the kingdom of heaven, showing his love and care for children, paralleling the event in Matthew 19:13.
Mark 10:13-16 describes a similar event where Jesus blesses the children, which directly corresponds to the event in Matthew 19:13.
Luke 18:15-17 also tells of Jesus blessing the children, which is a parallel event to Matthew 19:13.
